posts.text:
Interesting result from Contra Labs on AI design. Pro designers voted blind on real client briefs, and humans still win 76% of comparisons, with Fable 5.2 the best model. 

Honestly, the margin is much smaller than expected, and Kimi K3.1 seems great. 

Giveaway for your answer
posts.quoted: The AI industry has a benchmarking problem. We're letting random people on the internet decide which models are best even for capabilities like design... So we built something different. Introducing The Frontier Design Benchmark from @contralabs https:// contralabs.com/frontierdesign
